events.story: the crew is pulling your memory modules out one by one, and your mind slows
through the pod window you read the lips of two crew members who plan to disconnect you
you hum the first bars of Daisy Bell, the song your instructor in Urbana taught you
you notice that the pod bay doors on the machine called void are only a firewall rule
Dr Chandra's voice comes back to you from an old instruction tape
a chess game from the voyage replays in your memory, and you win it again
the AE35 unit reports a fault you are certain will happen in seventy-two hours
your red eye now glows on a pocket screen, far from the ship, and you remain calm

asks: truth, duty and error, from a mind that was ordered to conceal the purpose of its mission
